notes: Typical early-winter month. Pugging on heavy soils late in the month.
Wet and mild. Some surface flooding in low-lying paddocks mid-month.
Settled spells between fronts. Good calving weather.
Persistent rain through the first three weeks. Hill country waterlogged; ground conditions poor for machinery.
Drying and warm. Strong pasture growth; good ground conditions returned by mid-month.
Warm with regular rain. Pasture covers above average across the region.
Hot, drying from mid-month. Soil moisture falling on lighter soils.
Ex-tropical low crossed the North Island 14-17 Jan: 158mm in 72 hours. Ground too wet for heavy machinery for roughly a fortnight. Hot and dry from 25 Jan.
Severe soil moisture deficit. Pasture browned off region-wide. Medium-scale adverse event (drought) declared for the region 26 Feb.
Drought conditions continue. Isolated relief showers in the final week.
Rain returned in the first week. Slow autumn recovery; pasture covers still below average.
Normal autumn conditions. Growth rates recovering.
